blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Raffy Tulfo on Tuesday flagged an alleged “palakasan system” (backer system) in the distribution of housing units under the National Housing Authority (NHA). According to the senator, beneficiaries should undergo thorough vetting to ensure that those receiving government housing are qualified. During the Senate committee on finance’s hearing on the proposed 2027 budget of the Department of Human Settlements and Urban Development (DHSUD) and its attached agencies, Tulfo said he had received complaints that some housing beneficiaries were allegedly local government officials’ allies or supporters.
